meta.title: Saltline · Online Free-for-All
meta.description: Saltline: an online 3D port firefight in your browser. Free-for-all combat, 5-second respawns, server-wide voice, per-player mute, big-text chat and blocked-language filtering.

game.title: SALTLINE
game.tagline: Port Authority Breach Team · Saltline Docks · Berth 04

msg.serverError: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

gameText.按住“射击”并拖动追踪: Hold FIRE and drag to track
gameText.撤离成功。你也可以驾船离港，在整片外海自由航行。: Extraction complete. You can also take the boat out and sail the open sea.
gameText.港口的安保网络已经失控。切断三处上行链路，抵达撤离船。: The port security network is out of control. Cut three uplinks and reach the extraction boat.
gameText.港务局突入小队 — 一人突入，没有后援: Port Authority Breach Team — one operator, no backup
gameText.屏幕上可射击、瞄准、换弹、跳跃: On-screen fire, aim, reload and jump
gameText.如果浏览器无法锁定鼠标，请按住鼠标按键拖动视角（左键同时射击，右键同时瞄准）。方: If the browser cannot lock the pointer, hold a mouse button and drag to look (left fires, right aims). Arrow keys or
gameText.所有场景、机械与音效均由浏览器实时生成，无需下载任何资源。: Every scene, machine and sound is generated live in your browser. No downloads required.
gameText.开启后射击不消耗弹药，也无需换弹: Shots cost no ammo and reloading is disabled
gameText.W / S 推进 · A / D 转向 · 鼠标观察 · Shift 加速 ·: W / S thrust · A / D steer · Mouse look · Shift boost · Esc debrief
gameText.中继器仍在运行 — 撤离船不会在火力下等待: Relays still online — the extraction boat won't wait under fire.
gameText.突入队员，这里是控制中心。港口主管占据着泊位。切断它的三处上行链路 — 堆场、仓: Operator, this is Control. The port supervisor holds the berth. Cut its three uplinks — yard, warehouse, pier.
gameText.一处中继器已熄灭。它察觉到了 — 机械正在逼近。: One relay is down. It noticed — machines are closing in.
gameText.两处已熄灭。它正把剩余的一切都压向你。: Two down. It is throwing everything left at you.
gameText.三处全部熄灭。撤离船停在码头南端的梯子旁。快跑。: All three are down. The extraction boat waits by the ladder at the south end of the pier. Run.
gameText.它发现你了。海鸥会飞，猎犬会跑。全部击倒。: It found you. Gulls fly, hounds run. Take them all down.
gameText.你伤得很重。躲到钢板后喘口气。: You're badly hurt. Get behind steel and breathe.
gameText.浅水区 · 请绕行外海: Shallow water · Take the open sea
gameText.鼠标锁定不可用 — 移动鼠标观察视角，停在屏幕边缘可继续转向 · 点击射击 ·: Pointer lock unavailable — move the mouse to look, edge-steer to keep turning · click to fire · arrow keys or IJKL also steer
gameText.点击画面锁定鼠标: Click the view to lock the pointer
gameText.鼠标已锁定 — 按 Esc 释放: Pointer locked — press Esc to release
gameText.继续行动将重新锁定鼠标。: Resume will lock the pointer again.
gameText.画质修改立即生效；阴影与反射可能需要片刻重建。: Quality changes apply immediately; shadows and reflections may rebuild for a moment.
gameText.突入队员已登船。盐线行动已断网。干得漂亮。: Operator aboard. Saltline is offline. Good work.
gameText.已为此设备自动选择画质（低）。如果帧率不足，请调低画质。: Auto quality for this device (Low). Lower it if the frame rate drops.
gameText.已为此设备自动选择画质（中）。如果帧率不足，请调低画质。: Auto quality for this device (Medium). Lower it if the frame rate drops.
gameText.已为此设备自动选择画质（高）。如果帧率不足，请调低画质。: Auto quality for this device (High). Lower it if the frame rate drops.
gameText.已为此设备自动选择画质（极高）。如果帧率不足，请调低画质。: Auto quality for this device (Ultra). Lower it if the frame rate drops.
gameText.撤离船不会在火力下等待: The extraction boat won't wait under fire
gameText.方向键或 IJKL 也可转向: Arrow keys or IJKL also steer
gameText.如果帧率不足，请调低画质。: Lower the quality if the frame rate drops.
gameText.突入队员，这里是控制中心。港口主管占据着泊位。切断它的三处上行链路: Operator, this is Control. The port supervisor holds the berth. Cut its three uplinks
gameText.推进 · A / D 转向 · 鼠标观察 · Shift 加速 · Esc 返回: Thrust · A / D steer · Mouse look · Shift boost · Esc debrief
gameText.一处中继器已熄灭。它察觉到了: One relay is down. It noticed
gameText.移动鼠标观察视角，停在屏幕边缘可继续转向: Move the mouse to look; edge-steer to keep turning

soldierSelect.title: Choose Unit
soldierSelect.intro: Both soldiers, the machine hound and the aerial drone share the same combat, voice and comms access. The hound runs low; the drone can gain altitude. Your choice is synced to every online player.
soldierSelect.maleDesc: A grounded frontal assault operator with jungle tactical gear and heavy armour for a commanding presence.
soldierSelect.femaleDesc: A light, agile vanguard with pale tactical gear and a sharp silhouette built for rapid flanking.
soldierSelect.houndDesc: The port hound's quadruped chassis, running low for fast cover transit and direct assaults.
soldierSelect.droneDesc: The port gull drone's rotor chassis can gain altitude while keeping the same fire, voice and comms access as infantry.
soldierSelect.previewHint: Rendered live with the in-game skeleton and materials
soldierSelect.fallback: 3D preview unavailable — you can still deploy
soldierSelect.note: Your choice is synced to every player and remembered next time
soldierSelect.settingsNote: Switch between soldiers, the machine hound and the drone in Settings; the choice is synced to other players
soldierSelect.aria: Choose a soldier, machine hound or aerial drone
